steps.text: Cream sugar, butter and vanilla. Add a small amount of milk (1 to 2 tablespoons). Add cocoa if desired and beat until fluffy. If frosting is too sweet add a little more milk.

raw_recipe.headline: Vanilla - Chocolate Powdered Sugar Frosting
raw_recipe.description: Confectioners' sugar, butter, milk, vanilla extract, and cocoa powder are all it takes to make this recipe for a delicious frosting.
raw_recipe.name: Vanilla - Chocolate Powdered Sugar Frosting

recipeInstructions.text: Cream sugar, butter and vanilla. Add a small amount of milk (1 to 2 tablespoons). Add cocoa if desired and beat until fluffy. If frosting is too sweet add a little more milk.

review.reviewBody: I took the reviews into consideration while making this for cupcakes, and didn't want them too sugary, so I added 3 tbsp cocoa pwdr. and kept everthing else the same as the recipe called for. My icing came out so thick and I think I might have figured out why some are having problems with it being too thin. If you are using margering instead of butter, there is a higher content of water in it. This frosting is fantastic for cupcakes, nice and thick if you use butter. I'll be keeping this easy and delicous recipe.

Great recipe! I made the chocolate version. This recipe is great as is, but personal preference - I ended up doubling the amount of cocoa powder. As a result, I also needed to add an extra Tablespoon of milk to get it to the perfect spreading consistency. I mixed it with the wire whisk attachment in my stand mixture until it had the texture of whipped frosting. This is now my go-to chocolate frosting recipe - try this and you will never want to buy canned frosting again!

Powdered sugar frosting, basic buttercream frosting, whatever you want to call it this recipe has the perfect proportions of butter to powdered sugar. I made the vanilla version and didn't measure the milk, just added enough to get the consistency I wanted. For novice cooks, it is important to cream the butter and sugar well, a good few minutes, until it is very light and fluffy! Update 11-19-12: The chocolate variation of this recipe, while fluffy and delicious, is a very LIGHT chocolate. If you like it darker, replace some of the powdered sugar with more cocoa powder.

Super quick and easy! I opted for the chocolate flavour. I used 3 tbs of cacao powder. And for milk, I used 2 tbs of almond milk. The almond milk didn’t seem to make it creamy enough so I added an additional 2 tbs of 5% cream and it turned out amazing!!! So creamy!!

I make homemade frosting all the time!. I prefer homemade to the store bought stuff. No offense Betty Crocker. For those of you getting a thin consistency frosting there are 2 things you can do. 1) Add about 1/4 cup of vegetable shortening. This will definitely thicken it and give you a better consistency without losing the flavor. Or 2) slow down your mixer. When you cream the ingredients together too quickly you melt the butter making it soupy. Also, use less milk if the butter is really soft. I HOPE THIS HELPS!!! Happy frosting! :)

I needed a guide for Keto frosting- this was perfect! Substituted the confectioners sugar with Keto powdered sugar (Swerve), heavy cream for milk- followed rest of ingredients/preparation directions. Perfect!

I did use a half cup of cream cheese like one reviewer suggested and it turned out perfect. I used unsalted butter and I didn't need the salt to cut down on the sweetness when I added the cream cheese. Delicious recipe. It covered an entire 9"×13" cake with enough leftover to make some muffins or donuts with a drizzle.

Very good recipe as is. I thought the chocolate flavor was a bit on the light side so I doubled the cocoa and milk. Not too dark and not too light, just right. I mixed for about 4 minutes, until the color changes from dark to light. 2 notes: 1. Sift the cocoa and sugar together and the frosting will be super duper smooth. 2. Add just a pinch of salt if you are using UNSALTED butter. Salt enhances the chocolate flavor. There's my 2 cents!

WAY TOO SWEET! I used a mixer after creaming the butter, sugar and vanilla by hand and it thickened up nicely while adding the liquid. I also used creamer instead of milk, and just added a little at a time until I liked the consistency.

Love this frosting, quick, easy, and flavorful. Needed a last minute recipe and this was perfect. Took Naples34102 advice to add milk until desired consistency. I used salted butter; therefore, no salt had to be added. I also used clear vanilla to keep the color white. Recipe doesn't make three cups, estimate one to 1 1/2 cups. Had to double recipe to have enough to frost two layer 8" cake.

This is a nice, easy frosting. I made it as vanilla, then split it to make half chocolate to see how each tasted on my vanilla cupcakes.

I agree with some reviewers who said the vanilla is sweeter - it definitely is. But I don't mind a bit of sweetness.

This definitely needs to be doubled to frost 24 cupcakes or fill and frost a cake though. I managed to get 16 cupcakes frosted by seriously skimping on my piping. 

Overall a tasty, easy and quick frosting in a pinch.
I loved this recipe! It’s perfect! Very rich.

I just realized that I added a comment from August 2024!! I usually don't comment on recipes, but this frosting was very easy to make and yes it was sweet but of course I decreased the amount of sugar because if I added too much milk then the frosting would been more like icing than frosting! I used this for my cupcakes and it was great.
Very easy recipe to make , I only had 6oz of cream cheese but it still came out delicious.
perfect (almost) really fluffy!!
I made this for lemon cupcakes! It was so good! You all should use this recipe.

Used it on top of chocolate cupcakes. Perfect consistency and flavor. Per other reviews I add a sea salt and cut the milk to 1 tbsp and it was perfect. Salt really helped make it less sweet. My guests loved this. Might be the best frosting I’ve had so far!
Easy recipe! I wanted frosting for some large cinnamon rolls so I cut the recipe in half, perfect! This will be a favorite for me. Thank you for sharing.
So watery
Super easy! Good taste and consistency. This recipe doesn’t make enough. Next time I will increase it by 1.5. Also, I advise using clear vanilla.
